issues.title: Account security and hacking concerns
issues.summary: Reviewers report their accounts being hacked, phished, or accessed by unknown devices/people without their consent.

issues.title: App fails to open or launch
issues.summary: Reviewers say the app won't open, gets stuck on the splash screen, or freezes on launch.

issues.title: Login failures
issues.summary: Reviewers report being unable to log in to their accounts, often receiving errors like 'something went wrong' or incorrect credentials messages.

issues.title: Other account access restrictions
issues.summary: Reviewers describe miscellaneous access problems such as region/country restrictions, locked content, and inability to use the app after changing location.

issues.title: Sign-up and account creation problems
issues.summary: Reviewers report difficulty creating new accounts, with issues entering phone numbers, verifying emails, or completing registration.

issues.title: Incorrect charges and refund issues
issues.summary: Reviewers report being charged multiple times, charged after cancellation, or not receiving refunds for unauthorized payments.

issues.title: Other billing and monetization complaints
issues.summary: Reviewers express general frustration with Spotify's monetization practices, invoicing, and unclaimed rewards.

issues.title: Features locked behind Premium subscription
issues.summary: Reviewers complain that basic playback controls like skipping, repeating, and choosing songs are restricted to paying Premium subscribers.

issues.title: Subscription price too high
issues.summary: Reviewers say the Premium subscription cost is too expensive and feel pressured to pay for basic functionality.

issues.title: Premium subscription activation problems
issues.summary: Reviewers report paying for Premium but not receiving the subscription benefits, or having trouble managing/cancelling their plan.

issues.title: Lyrics not displaying correctly
issues.summary: Reviewers report lyrics failing to load, missing entirely, or not syncing properly with the song.

issues.title: Songs and content missing from catalog
issues.summary: Reviewers say specific songs, artists, or genres they want are unavailable or have disappeared from the app.

issues.title: Other content and feature gaps
issues.summary: Reviewers mention miscellaneous content issues including missing Wrapped results, local files not showing, and podcast transcript unavailability.

issues.title: Poor shuffle and recommendations
issues.summary: Reviewers complain that shuffle repeats the same songs and that recommended tracks don't match their preferences.

issues.title: Search function not working
issues.summary: Reviewers report that search fails to find songs, artists, or playlists, or that search functionality has been removed or broken.

issues.title: Downloaded content disappearing
issues.summary: Reviewers report downloaded songs and podcasts vanishing unexpectedly or needing to be redownloaded repeatedly.

issues.title: Offline playback not working
issues.summary: Reviewers say downloaded songs won't play without an internet connection despite having downloaded them for offline use.

issues.title: Other download limitations
issues.summary: Reviewers mention missing download options, inability to download without Premium, and lack of SD card download support.

issues.title: General app dissatisfaction
issues.summary: Reviewers express broad dissatisfaction with the app, describing it as buggy, worsening over time, or simply bad overall.

issues.title: Poor audio quality
issues.summary: Reviewers report low sound quality, distorted audio, or quiet volume compared to other music apps.

issues.title: False 'no internet connection' errors
issues.summary: Reviewers report the app incorrectly claiming they are offline or have no internet connection, blocking playback despite a working connection.

issues.title: App crashes and freezes
issues.summary: Reviewers report the app crashing, freezing, or hanging frequently, sometimes requiring a device restart.

issues.title: Playback issues with external devices
issues.summary: Reviewers report problems with sound output to headphones, Bluetooth, Android Auto, and other connected devices.

issues.title: General inability to play music
issues.summary: Reviewers report that the app simply fails to play songs at all, with no sound or response when pressing play.

issues.title: Excessive battery, data, and memory use
issues.summary: Reviewers report the app draining battery, consuming excessive data, or running constantly in the background.

issues.title: Music stops or skips unexpectedly
issues.summary: Reviewers report playback randomly stopping, pausing, or songs failing to start after an update.

issues.title: Customer support difficulties
issues.summary: Reviewers describe trouble reaching or getting useful responses from Spotify's customer support team.

issues.title: No access to live customer support
issues.summary: Reviewers say there is no way to talk to a live person or get direct support for their account issues.

issues.title: Too many and too frequent ads
issues.summary: Reviewers complain about excessive advertisements interrupting music and podcasts, even for paying users.

issues.title: Playback controls not working as expected
issues.summary: Reviewers report issues with repeat, shuffle, and search buttons not functioning or disappearing from the interface.

issues.title: Disliked app redesign and new UI
issues.summary: Reviewers express frustration with recent interface redesigns, citing lost features and a worse user experience.

issues.title: Playlist and library management problems
issues.summary: Reviewers report issues viewing, editing, or accessing their liked songs, playlists, and queue after updates.

issues.title: Miscellaneous usability complaints
issues.summary: Reviewers mention various smaller issues such as broken links, lack of sharing options, and missing parental controls.

note: Membership is assigned by code from the enriched subtopic; the model only names issues.
